mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in housing starts signals a robust demand for housing, which in turn drives economic growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong housing starts growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate below 2% triggers an expansionary monetary policy, leading to increased borrowing and spending, and ultimately resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate, combined with a strong increase in payroll employment, signals a tight labor market, which drives wage growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of low unemployment and strong payroll growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in industrial production signals a robust supply chain, which drives economic growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong industrial production growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the consumer price index below 2% triggers a disinflationary environment, leading to increased consumer spending, and ultimately resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in disinflationary periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A high federal funds rate, combined with a strong increase in GDP, signals a strong economy, which drives economic growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of high federal funds rate and strong GDP growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate triggers a contractionary labor market, leading to decreased consumer spending, and ultimately resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in contractionary labor market periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in retail sales, combined with a low unemployment rate, signals a robust consumer demand, which drives economic growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong retail sales growth and low unemployment (t-test p > 0.05).
